name: frida_scripts
description: Frida hook scripts for android-analyzer. Sources live in src/ and import frida-java-bridge (required since Frida 16 dropped the auto-injected Java global for raw scripts). Run `npm run build` to compile them to the bundled .js files that views.py actually loads.

scripts.build: for f in src/*.js; do name=$(basename "$f"); npx frida-compile "$f" -o "$name"; done
